statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
The patient has diagnosis I48.91 (unspecified atrial fibrillation)
The patient has a history of transient ischemic attack
The patient has a history of cerebral infarction
CPT 93271 (prolonged cardiac rhythm monitoring) was billed
The claim was denied with reason code CO-97
The denial reason is that the service is bundled into another covered procedure and is not separately payable
Prolonged cardiac rhythm monitoring is clinically indicated to evaluate arrhythmia burden and guide anticoagulation management
